name: Guangxi Oriental Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangxi Oriental Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture, development and sale of electronic measuring instruments. Its products include electronic digital caliper, dial caliper, depth gages, height gages, data collection system, electronic digital micrometer, electronic digital indicator, tester and other intelligent and digital precision instruments. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Guilin, China.
